title: Yoni Mudra Art Gallery

services.name: Yoga class
services.desc: A gentle midday gathering in sisterhood - a space to soften, land and return to yourself through the quiet language of the rose. This weekly meditation is a rose-infused journey inward: slowing down, tuning into your body and opening a little more gently to the wisdom of your heart. Through breath, visualization, embodied stillness and gentle movement, we journey through the unfolding petals of the inner rose - softening the heart, connecting to our womb and remembering the beauty held within. Each gathering becomes a ritual of remembrance - a moment to pause, be held in sisterhood and receive whatever wants to be felt, softened or witnessed. There may be moments of gentle movement,
